description.value: The Craigmyle is a heritage boutique hotel with 15 individually decorated rooms and suites, situated two minutes' walk from Craigdarroch Castle in Victoria's Rockland neighbourhood. It operates on a no-daily-housekeeping model, emphasises environmental sustainability (chemical-free laundry, linen reuse program), and offers flexible self-check-in/check-out — practical for cyclists arriving on their own schedule. The property explicitly warns of many stairs throughout the building, which is worth noting for cyclists travelling with heavily loaded bikes.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 38m; rack at 41m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone, email all match). The amenities page is partially truncated but covers most key offerings; the site explicitly confirms free Wi-Fi, a guest laundry room, and luggage storage arrangements with the innkeeper. No bike-specific storage, bike procedure, or e-bike charging is mentioned anywhere on the site; the repeated 'LOT OF STAIRS' notice is contextually relevant to loaded-bike access but is not explicit negative evidence for any specific amenity. The hotel self-describes as a 'BBKB' with the letters expanded in truncated text starting with 'Bed' — a possible 'Bikes' category cannot be confirmed from the available text.
concerns: Amenities page content was truncated mid-sentence ('Free parking is ava...'), so the full amenities list including any bike-related offerings could not be verified.
The hotel repeatedly emphasises 'A LOT OF STAIRS' with no elevator, which may pose practical challenges for cyclists with loaded touring bikes or e-bikes — but no explicit policy on bikes is stated.
The property self-describes as 'BBKB' with individual letter categories; the truncated text prevents confirming whether the final 'B' refers to 'Bikes', which could indicate a bike-specific amenity.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating boutique hotel in Victoria with an active website and confirmed contact details; useful to touring cyclists as overnight accommodation.
enrichment_extras.notes: The hotel offers an optional breakfast (described in the 'BBKB' framework and the amenities page) but details on whether it can be arranged early or as a packed breakfast were not available in the fetched content.

Laundry.detail: Guest laundry room available on-site; website states 'Fresh towels are available at any time in our guest laundry room.'

Luggage storage.detail: Website states: 'You may make arrangements with our Innkeeper to leave your luggage with us safely if you arrive earlier or wish to leave later.'
